measured: application callers read at their scanned commits, third-party opt-ins recorded in optional, Volter products retained in full (Open Autonomy setup/workflows, RH2 selected recording provider, twin-world rehearsal/catalog walk). wrangler@4.137.0 was read from npm pack at the version Open Autonomy pins; platform wrangler@4.143.0 remains its own caller. No mock/test/maintainer release script counts. Open Autonomy pins Hermes 29112bef099274229cadff79cdff7bf7b99c4b77 (container/hermes.pin:5-7); .open-autonomy/agent.json:18-36 configures terminal local and disables browser-use, and its Discord platform toolset is hermes-discord. The pinned raw toolsets.py:31-90 and 478-481 default core/CLI tools name no Cloudflare API or R2 integration; these generic web/terminal/browser tools provide no additional Cloudflare-specific default call. The product setup Cloudflare calls above remain demand. A configured provider is still in pack scope where the customer life uses it, independent of optional application demand. volter-ai/sites (11e64f9) is read for what wrangler deploy sends from each site's folder in a World before the real deploy (its wrangler.jsonc files, scripts/release-hostname.mjs and .volter/seeds/story.ts). Supplying credentials alone does not make a shipped feature optional: Dub’s storage, Twenty’s custom domains, Cal.com sign-up CAPTCHA, Rallly login CAPTCHA and LibreChat’s shipped login widget are demand. Postiz storage remains optional because upload.factory.ts:15 selects local by default; Twenty CAPTCHA remains optional because CAPTCHA_DRIVER selects its implementation. No served operation is removed.
